regions.region: page 1 title, authors, journal metadata, and abstract text
regions.finding: The abstract describes the reaction class and oxidant systems; it does not report a row-specific experiment or yield.
Generic R-group cyclization-Heck scheme classified as a general_scheme, with Pd catalyst and alternative CaH2(cat.)/NaI(cat.)/O2 or BQ (1 equiv) systems; not treated as an individual experiment.
Background and cited prior work only; no experiments from the present paper were created from these citations.

unresolved: Generic R groups prevent assignment of specific substrate/product structures.
The abstract arrow omits time, temperature, and exact Pd identity/loading.

regions.finding: Proposed catalytic cycle classified as mechanism: cyclic nucleopalladation, alkene insertion, beta-H elimination, Pd(0) formation, and oxidant-mediated regeneration of Pd(II).
Distinct reported experiment: 1a plus acrylonitrile with 4 equiv CuCl2, 4 equiv K2CO3, 5 mol% PdCl2(PhCN)2 in DMF at 60 °C gives 3a (34%) and E-2a (14%).

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, rows 1-14, and footnotes a-g
regions.finding: Fourteen independent optimization entries extracted row by row. Common 60 °C/24 h/DMF/PdCl2(PhCN)2 conditions, oxidant or halide column, CaH2/NaH overrides, atmosphere/apparatus exceptions, E-2a and Z-2a NMR yields, trace result, and measurement basis were preserved.
Discussion links the optimization conditions to Table 1; cited literature is not treated as experiments from this paper.

unresolved: Scheme 2 does not state time, atmosphere, workup, purification, or yield measurement basis.
Table 1 does not state amounts of 1a or acrylonitrile.
Table 1 product structures were not assigned SMILES because their connectivity/stereochemistry was not independently verified from the drawings.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 reaction header, rows 1-16, and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Sixteen independent substrate-scope entries extracted row by row, including all R-group labels, alkenes, conditions A/B, isolated yields, E/Z statements, the 100 °C override, and the 25% isolated 4a byproduct in entry 3.
Provides context for entries 5-14 and explicitly states that 4a formation was less than 2%, if any; this evidence was merged into the corresponding Table 1 records rather than creating duplicates.
Confirms scope interpretation and reports yields for 2i/2j that conflict with Table 2: prose 64%/66% versus table 61%/86%. Both source statements were retained and flagged unresolved.
Citations and summary only; no additional present-paper experiment was created.

unresolved: Source-internal conflicts remain for 2i (61% table versus 64% prose) and 2j (86% table versus 66% prose).
Condition B says overnight without a numeric duration or stated atmosphere.
Workup, purification, and complex substrate/product SMILES are not supplied in the main text.

regions.finding: General conclusion that products were formed regio- and stereoselectively; no new experiment, table row, scheme arrow, or numeric result appears.
Funding information only; no reaction record.
The main text says synthesis and characterization for 2 and 3a are available online, but no SI file was explicitly supplied or associated; no SI facts were imported.

unresolved: Supporting information is mentioned but not provided or explicitly associated, so missing procedures and characterization remain unresolved.
